outcome: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) vertical transmission rate
HBV DNA decrease in mothers at delivery
cohort: 893 mothers with chronic hepatitis B and HBV DNA > 10^6 IU/mL, receiving Telbivudine or Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate during the second to third trimester of pregnancy, along with their 854 infants.
finding: Telbivudine and Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate treatments were well tolerated and showed comparable efficacy in reducing mother-to-child transmission of HBV, with a higher risk of MTCT observed in pregnant women with HBsAg > 4 log10 IU/mL.
